entities.summary: Estrella Eleanor Carothers was an American zoologist, geneticist, and cytologist known for her work with grasshoppers. She discovered important physical evidence for the concept of Chromosome_segregation giving direct observational support for Mendelian independent assortment, vital to modern understanding of genetics.
